schema_version_note: Schema 2.0 widens 1.0's single `module` field into the `scope` object and adds `historical_projection_id`. Version bumped explicitly rather than reinterpreting 1.0 fields.
projection_lineage_note: Bootstrapped as LOOPIA_P01 (P01-only). Widened by owner decision to the largest coherent, already-built, owner-gated, no-external-effect SME product slice. The repository name remains historical. See PROJECT_BOUNDARY.md.

head_resolution.method: git fetch origin main && git rev-parse origin/main
head_resolution.projection_move_note: `projection_moved` records whether the LIVE head differed from what this file expected at resolution time, not whether the branch has ever advanced. It is false because the two agree. The expectation itself was re-based this pass: PR #2 merged as 69d2e5d, whose second parent is the audited head c412f11, and `git diff c412f11 69d2e5d` is empty — the merged tree IS the audited tree, so the merge introduced nothing that had not been reviewed. The previous value, cd56c206, was the base the PR merged INTO and is now history.
head_resolution.canonical_reresolved_note: Re-fetched at the start of the repair pass. Canonical has not moved since the pin, so no AUTHORITY_CHANGE was raised and the P07-A conformance vectors generated from it speak for the pinned head.

claim_boundary_semantics.note: The ten booleans below are NOT all the same kind of statement, and editing one as if it were the others is the mistake this block exists to prevent. A permanent authority lock is an owner act recorded upstream; no evidence collected on any host can support one, and they stay false. An evidence-backed operational state is an observation, and it may be true ONLY while deployment-evidence.json carries a record supporting it. no_external_charge_executed is neither: it stays true.
claim_boundary_semantics.enforced_by: tests/foundation/lock_invariants.php and tests/foundation/deployment_evidence_boundary.php — the first holds the locks false, the second refuses any operational state asserted true without a record supporting it.
